pre_build: export RUSTUP_HOME=/w/build/rust-toolchain/rustup CARGO_HOME=/w/build/rust-toolchain/cargo PATH=/w/build/rust-toolchain/cargo/bin:$PATH; [ -x $CARGO_HOME/bin/rustup ] || curl -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --no-modify-path --profile minimal --default-toolchain none >/dev/null; rustup toolchain list | grep -q nightly-2026-09-01 || rustup toolchain install nightly-2026-09-01 --profile minimal -c rust-src >/dev/null; cd dsp && RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+atomics,+bulk-memory,+mutable-globals -C relocation-model=pic' cargo +nightly-2026-09-01 rustc --locked --release -p piano --target wasm32-unknown-emscripten -Zbuild-std=core,alloc --crate-type staticlib

mkdir -p dist && : > dist/dsp.so && sed '/verify-package/d' scripts/package.sh > scripts/.wasm-package.sh && bash scripts/.wasm-package.sh && rm -f dist/piano-practice/dsp.so dist/piano-practice-module.tar.gz
wasm_notes: Rust no_std crate built with a pinned nightly (nightly-2026-09-01, installed by pre_build into build/rust-toolchain) for wasm32-unknown-emscripten as a staticlib with -Zbuild-std=core,alloc, +atomics,+bulk-memory,+mutable-globals and relocation-model=pic (required to link into a -pthread SIDE_MODULE; the prebuilt core lacks atomics), then linked --whole-archive by emcc. Packaging = upstream scripts/package.sh minus its aarch64 verify step.
upstream_build: scripts/build-dsp.sh: cargo build --release --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu (dsp/ workspace, cdylib libpiano.so -> dsp.so); scripts/package.sh: piano-practice/{module.json,ui.js,<mod>-<BUILD_ID>.mjs,dsp.so,help.json,exercises/*.json,README.md,LICENSE,THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md}
